Commentary.Commentary: England are now favourites to win the series 4-1. Their bowlers now will come out fresh and they would hope to get a few breakthroughs with 18 overs remaining in the day. The Indian batters on the other hand, will have to take it session by session. Their first task will be to battle out today without losing too many wickets, actually they would hope they do not lose any. The pitch does look a good one to bat on but it is not going to be easy. Do India have some fight left in them or will the English bowlers run rampant? We will find out in some time.

So, England have finally declared. They batted for around 8 overs before they did so but have added almost 60 runs. They have now set a mammoth target of 464 runs and they have close to 3.5 sessions to bowl this Indian side out. They entered into their second innings with a decent advantage of 40 runs. They lost Jennings early but then did not look back after that. Alastair Cook and Joe Root joined forces and they tired the visitors' players out there. They batted, batted and batted adding a massive 259-run stand. Yes, they did ride their luck but take nothing away from the way they played. Both registered tons and ensured they batted the away side out of the game.

OUT! In the air... and caught! Curran walks and England declare as well. He goes after another biggie but couldn't get to the pitch of the ball which was flighted in line of the sticks. He still goes after the ball and ends up top-edging it. The ball lobs towards short square leg and Pant runs to complete the formalities. Joe Root signals from the balcony to end India's agony. The target is 464. They'll have to beat their overall highest if they are to win this.
SIX! The runs continue to flow. Tossed up outside off, a bit wide, but no problem for Sam. He dances out, gets to the pitch of the ball and sends it sailing over widish long off.
Full and outside off, Curran looks to play the reverse sweep but misses.
FOUR! And again. Declaration is around the corner it seems. A slow ball but shortish. Rashid goes back and square cuts it through cover-point for another boundary. 12 came off this one.
FOUR! Oh, this is a beauty! Rashid lofts this on over the mid on fielder  and gets it to the fence easily. Runs coming thick and fast.
Lead up to 451 now. This time Rashid times this shortish ball outside off with an angled bat. The ball goes to the deep and a brace results.
Rashid looks to guide it past slip but fails.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

In the air... but safe! Slow, outside off, it grips and turns. Rashid again goes after it with hard hands and the ball takes the top edge. The ball hangs in the air towards backward point but there is no fielder to catch it. A couple taken.
Adil plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Dancing shoes on display here. Rashid charges down and gets it on full. The connection is sweet and it races through covers for a boundary.
Rough comes into play. It lands there and bounces and Rashid does well to get out of the way. No harm done.
On the pads, played to the on side for no run.
Paddles it fine and gets to the other end. It was loopy ball outside leg and Rashid does well to get bat on it to get the total to 400 runs for the first time in this series for either team.
Hangs back and keeps it out off the back foot.
Hanuma Vihari to roll his arm over now.
Drives it through covers and keeps the strike for the next over.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Adil Rashid is in.

OUT! In the air... taken! One shot too many, Stokes. A flatter delivery on middle and leg, Stokes reaches for it from his crease and slog it over square leg region. KL Rahul, in the deep there positions himself under it and holds onto it nicely to complete his 14th catch of the series. He goes past Rahul Dravid's record of 13 catches with this.
FOUR! And another! What power he has. Stokes is making his and his team's intentions clear here. A flighted ball on off, driven past the covers fielder for a boundary.
Drives the full ball to mid on for no run.
SIX! Bang! A mere chip off the front foot and it goes the distance. Wow! Stokes gets a flighted ball on middle and off, he lofts it to wide long on for a maximum.
Curran plays and miss now. Short of a length ball outside off. It comes in with the angle from 'round the wicket and them moves away after landing. Curran plays inside the line and misses.
Bye! Shortish ball down the leg side, Pant fails to hang on to it and concedes a bye.
Chops the short of a length ball through backward point for a run.
Hangs back and gets it through cover-point for a run.
A play and a miss to follow. Similar length, a touch too wide. Stokes fails to play the similar shot to this one.
Four! Up and over. Lead climbs to 424. Stokes making his intentions clear. A short ball outside off, Stokes goes after it with hard hands and get it up and over the slip cordon. A boundary results.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.

FOUR! Beautiful. Curran has played spin extremely well throughout his short International career. He played Ashwin well and now he is milking Jadeja well. He gets a short ball on off, spinning in. Curran goes back and times it through covers. No chance for any fielder to get anywhere near it.
Short outside off, cut to backward for a run.

Ouch! This will sting! A full ball on middle and leg, Stokes looks to slog sweep it, middles it and straight on the helmet of short leg fielder, Vihari. He seems to have got into the firing line bad as he is seen rubbing his forehead. Goo thing from Stokes who goes up to him and asks about his whereabouts. A mandatory concussion test being done by the physio. Hope is fine!

Similar length on the pads, punched through mid-wicket for another easy run. Not sure what approach the English batters have here. They are happy to take singles and not go for boundaries straightaway.
Shortish, punched off the back foot down the ground for a run.
Beats another edge, Shami. Not his day, not his innings, not his Test. Curran plays the line but gets beats on the outside.
Short outside off, pushed through the point region. A run results.
FOUR! Shot! Crisp! On off, driven on the up down the ground and beats the fielder at mid on. A boundary.
Chops it through backward point and changes strike.
Hangs back and gets it through cover-point for a run.
Shami beats the outside edge once again. How many he must be asking. Anyway, it was outside off and Stokes misses to put bat to ball.
Mohammed Shami from the other end.
Forward and kept out for no run.
That spun in viciously off the rough. Sam goes back to defend it. A dangerous thing to do.
Comes down the track and pushes it back to the bowler.
Punched off the back foot through the off side for an easy run.
An inside edge there. Similar length on off, Curran lunges forward to bat it out. On run taken from the on side.
Slow, around off, pushed to the off side.

We are back for the final session. 28 overs to go in it, so it probably won't be a long one. Curran and Stokes make their way out and I don't think we will be batting for long as the declaration will be around the corner. Ravindra Jadeja will start the proceedings. Here we go...
... Day 4, Session 3 ...

The quick wickets though will not make a lot of difference as the lead has already crossed the 400-run mark. Now it is a matter of time before the English side declares and put India in. How long? Was the question at the Lunch break and it still is. One however would say the wait could be a lot shorter than the one after the Lunch break. Let's see how the play unfolds in the final session. Stay tuned.

So, another session in which we saw a lot of runs being scored. Once again it was the pair which dominated the bowling in the first session, Cook and Root. The two brought up their tons and then continued to milk the bowlers. The pair added 259 runs before Vihari struck twice to get rid of both of them. Then India enjoyed a good passage of play as after they took the new ball they were able to take some quick wickets.
Another ball which beats the outside edge! Good length again in the corridor of uncertainty. Curran hangs his bat out but gets beaten. THAT WILL BE TEA ON DAY 4!
Very full on middle, Curran strokes it towards mid on for a run.
Confident shot there! On the shorter side on off, Curran off the back foot, punches it through covers and takes two.

Beaten again! This time it also goes agonizingly close past the off pole. Another length ball coming in with the angle from outside off. Curran once again plays inside the line and the ball whizzes past the outside edge.
On the stumps this time, Curran defends it onto the ground.

Another gem! Shami stands there in the middle of the pitch and thinks, what more does he have to do, to get another wicket. On a length around off, this one pitches and straightens. Curran plays inside the line and gets beaten.
Curran goes back to this quicker one on the stumps from RJ and turns it around into the mid-wicket region to cross over and retain strike.
A similar delivery is treated similarly, this time by the other left-hander. One more run to the total. England's lead now reaches 400. Is the game out of India's reach now?
Tossed up but a bit straighter this time. Curran leans across and flicks towards mid-wicket for a single.
Flights this one a bit more around off, Curran comes forward nicely to defend it.
Beaten! Jaddu fires this fuller and outside off. Curran plays for the non-existent spin and gets beaten.
Tossed up on off, Curran prods forward and blocks it out.
Very very similar to the third ball of the over. The only difference, if any, is that the ball dropped just a bit short of first slip.
Shami lands this one a but shorter of a good length outside off. Stokes tries to keep it out but plays the wrong line and misses the ball.
Wide outside off this, left alone.

Edged but does not carry! Shami continues in the corridor of uncertainty. It's too good for Stokes as he tries to keep it out from within the crease. The ball moves away ever so slightly on landing, taking Stokes' outer edge and flies towards first slip. However, the ball drops way short of Kohli and Stokes survives. The number of times Shami has either beaten the English batsmen's willows or induced an edge which fell short of a fielder in this innings, will definitely be more than the total number of misses induced by the other Indian bowlers put together. This says a lot about how unlucky he has been in this Test.
Short and wide outside off. Curran sees the width on this and cuts it deep point for a single.

Shami starts the new over with a length ball attacking the stump, angling into Curran. The English start of the series waits for the ball to arrive to him and tucks it into the on side with the inward movement. This young lad looks so solid in his defence.
Outside off, pushed to covers for a run. End of a successful over for India and spinners doing the work for them, finally.
In line of the stumps, blocked.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Superman of English cricket, Sam Curran, is in now. Let's see if he can do something different.

OUT! Buttler walks back! The norm continues after the mammoth partnership. Buttler, looking for quick runs, top edges one to Shami at backward point. It was a tossed up ball outside off, spinning away from the right-hander and he had a wild hoick across the line. These wickets, however, shouldn't bother the hosts too much as they have enough to win this match probably.
Drives the floated ball on down the ground.
Tossed up on off, pushed through the off side for a run.
Jos Buttler is the new man in.

OUT! If there is anyone who deserves a wicket, it has to be this man. Shami produces a beauty, yet again, but this time gets rewarded for it. He continues to attack that good length area around the corridor of the off stump. The ball lands and deviates into Jonny. The length is such that the English Keeper is not sure whether to come forward or rock back. This confusion makes him stay in the crease and he tries to block it out. The inward movement beats his inner edge and crashes into the timber. Shami gets his second of the in innings. The lead is now 395.

FOUR! Nailed the cut perfectly! Shami dishes this wide outside off and shorter in length. Bairstow reaches for it with a horizontal bat and cuts it into the point region. The placement is supreme as the fielder at the boundary line races across to try and stop it but cannot as the ball races across the deep point fence.

Beaten again! Excellent length from Shami and that does the batsman again. Jonny, not front not back, tries to keep it out but gets beaten again as this length ball on off cuts back into him on landing and beats his inside edge this time. He survives though.

Beaten! Shami still producing these beauties. He has been the unluckiest amongst all the Indian bowlers. Lands this a bit short of a good length just outside off. The ball pitches and cuts back into Jonny who looks to keep it out but gets beaten because of the movement.
Keeps it fuller and straighter, Stokes flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Starts with a short of a length ball just outside off, Jonny taps it towards point to run a single.

Keeps this one a bit slower by giving it a bit more air keeps it outside off, Stokes leans forward and looks to flick it into the mid-wicket region. The ball lands and spins in sharply, beating Stokes and rapping him on the thigh pad.
tossed up on off, defended off the front foot.
Stokes tries to cut this flatter and shorter one outside off but is beaten completely.
Stokes goes for the sweep but fails to connect it.

Jadeja fires this one on the off stump line and keeps it a bit shorter in length. Bairstow goes for the punch through covers but gets a bottom edge and the ball rolls towards the mid off region and the batsman take a quick single.
Jadeja continues with a tossed up ball just outside off. Jonny decides to shoulder arms to this but it was a bit risky. The ball lands and skids through whizzing past the off stump. That was close!
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Another top shot! Just ahead of a length around off, Stokes times it on the up through covers and the ball races to the fence.
FOUR! The slightest of room was enough for Stokes to put that away. Not a bad delivery, a little short and outside off, Stokes slaps it through covers for a boundary.
Back of a length on off, Jonny defends it onto the ground and the pair run through for a run.

More runs! Width on offer and with the one day mode on, JB won't let it go by. Full and outside off, he slashes hard and gets it through cover-point. Pujara in the deep runs to his left, slides and makes a good stop. Two taken by the batsmen.
Down the leg side, Bairstow tries to flick but misses.
A little too straight on middle, Stokes flicks it towards fine leg and takes a run.
A bit wider of the off stump and left alone by Jonny.
Jaddu corrects his line right and makes the batsman play, but Jonny is up for it and keeps it out off the back foot.
Wide of off again and Jonny shoulders arms again.
Tossed up but outside off, left alone by Jonny.

FOUR! Up and over! Bairstow now displaying his intent and in some style. Jadeja keeps this a bit slower and around off. Bairstow, from within the crease, swings through the line, gets good elevation and the ball goes over the mid on fielder to race across the long on boundary.
Tossed up on off, Stokes turns it around into the mid-wicket region to get off the mark.
Keeps it a bit wide of off and Bairstow, trying to get his eye in, leaves it alone watchfully.
A bit shorter and in line with the stumps, Bairstow gets behind the line and keeps it out.
Wider of off and left alone by Jonny.

FOUR! Watta shot! Bairstow cracks his first boundary in style. A shorter ball outside off is cut by the English wicket-keeper batsman and the timing on it is exquisite. The placement is even better as the ball races across the deep point fence.
Very short and way down the leg side. Left alone.
Starts with a short of a length delivery down the leg side.
Mohammed Shami comes into the attack. The second new ball has also been taken.

A bit slower and shorter outside off, Bairstow punches this off the back foot towards covers and takes off for a single. The fielder has a shy at the non-striker's but the bowler cannot stop the ball. The ball goes behind him and the batsmen think of stealing an overthrow but due to good backing up from the fielder in the deep, they cannot take the extra run. Bairstow gets off the pair.
Tossed up on the stumps, Bairstow leans ahead and flicks this one to mid-wicket with a wristy shot.
The English keeper has  defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Slower in the air and a bit shorter of full length, Bairstow stays back and keeps it out.
Slower and fuller on the stumps, Bairstow keeps it out off the front foot.
Tossed up slower around off, Bairstow comes forward and defends.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. End of a double wicket-maiden by Vihari.
Very full on middle, Stokes somehow digs it out.
Another one on the stumps, Stokes blocks it out.
No hat-trick but a good delivery. On off and coming back in with the angle. Stokes lunges and defends it.
Ben Stokes to face the hat-trick ball.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! End of Cook's innings, end of an era in English cricket. He bows out in some style, a magnificent innings by him and he walks off the field to a huge ovation from the crowd. Excellent gesture by the Indians too as they walk upto him and shake his hand. Such is the respect every player has for this guy and why not? His career is surely one to look back at. He was probably at his best today but falls in a tame manner. This is the last we have seen of him with the bat in Tests and it was a treat for all the cricketing fans. Coming to the delivery - It is a short ball, quicker in pace and outside off. Cook had been cutting these to the boundaries all day but this time he only edges it to Pant who makes no mistake behind the stumps. Two-in-two for the debutant, Vihari, he is now on a hat-trick.
Jonny Bairstow is the new man in.

OUT! Root holes out! All eyes at the England dressing room but there is no declaration. So, something to rejoice for India and a big moment for Vihari, his first Test wicket and a one he would not forget easily. Root walks back in disgust but he has played an extremely fluent innings. His 259-run stand with Cook has probably batted India out of the game. Now coming to the delivery - it was tossed up around off, Root goes for the slog sweep but gets a top edge. It carries towards the man at deep mid-wicket and Hardik Pandya, the substitute, there takes it.
Tossed up around off, Cook comes forward and works it towards mid-wicket.
Quicker and shorter on middle stump. Cooks tries to flick it but misses and gets rapped on the thigh pad.
Root skips down the track, looking for a biggie, but Jadeja pulls his length back and keeps it on off. Root goes through with the shot and the ball flies towards the mid on region for a run.
Tossed up around off, turned into the leg side with the spin and takes a single.
Fuller but a bit slower on off, the senior opener flicks it straight to the man at mid-wicket.
Fuller on off, driven to mid-wicket.
Cook sweep this slower and fuller ball to the deep square leg region to get a run and retain strike.
Floated and straighter on the stumps, Cook blocks it out with a straight bat.
Tossed up delivery on off, defended off the front foot.
Keeps it slower and a bit shorter outside off, Cook, who is initially looking to go for the sweep, changes his shot at the last moment and cuts it to the man at point.
Tossed up on off, driven to long on for a single.
Vihari starts the new over with a tossed up ball outside off. Root, looking to guide it late towards third man, is beaten because of some extra bounce and spin. Pant does well to collect it cleanly.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Bowls it with a round arm action and lands it aorund off, Root gets it off the inner half towards covers and runs through for a single.
Strokes it to mid on.
The batsman has played it to the point region. One run added to the total.
In the air... but no fielder and also it was not of the bat. Jadeja tosses it up outside off, it turns back in. Cook tries to defend but the ball hits the pads and lobs towards the leg side.
Slightly slower through the air outside off, Cook tries to guide it through point but misses.
Fires it on middle, kept out.
Eases it down to long off for a run.
A full toss, Cook plays the paddle sweep, it goes fine down the leg side and a couple results.
Flatter and drifts in from outside off, Cook jams it out at the very last moment.
Plays the paddle sweep well and crosses ends. 250 is now the partnership. This is surely draining the Indian players out, mentally and physically.
On the pads, Root flicks it to square leg.
Drinks!
Sweeps this ball, fired in on the leg stump leg, towards deep backward square leg for a run. They have a fielder in the deep as they know how well Root plays that shot.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Down the leg side, Root fails to put it away.
Works it with the angle to mid-wicket.
On the leg stump, Root goes for the sweep but misses to get hit on the pads. Jadeja puts in a loud appeal but nothing from the umpire. It pitched outside leg.
Flatter on middle, Root defends it off the back foot.
Root taps this floated ball around off towards the point region to get a run an retain strike. The lead is now 350.

Root picks the shorter length very early, rocks back and pulls it over the mid-wicket region. Shami from long on runs across and stops the ball from crossing the boundary with his boot. Batsmen come back for a brace.
Fuller and straighter ball is flicked to mid-wicket.
Vihara drops it a bit short and a bit outside off as well, Cook cuts this nicely to the deep point region for a single.
Tossed up delivery on off, swept to square leg region for a single.
Slower and a bit shorter on off, Root defends off the back foot.
Hanuma Vihari is back on.
A bit flatter and fuller around off, defended by Cook off the front foot.
Floated and in line with the stumps, turned away to mid-wicket.
Jadeja fires this one on his pads, Root flicks it to square leg for a single.
Cook brings the broom out and sweeps this fuller tossed up ball in line with the off stump towards square leg region to add a run to the score.

FOUR! A bit shorter and flatter and a bit outside off. Cook waits for it to arrive and at the last moment opens his bat face to glide it down to the third man area to get a boundary. 300 comes up for the hosts. They are rubbing it in now.
Tossed up in line with the stumps, turned away to mid-wicket.
Similar length to the previous ball but the line is on the leg stump. Cook flicks this one towards the deep fine leg region to retain the strike.
A very full delivery attacking the stumps. Cook drives this one to mid off.
A bit shorter outside off, punched through the covers by Root to get another run.
A shorter of length delivery on the stumps, defended from within the crease.
Fires this one on a length but on the pads of the England skipper. He is playing on 112 and will not miss out on these as he flicks this towards square leg region for a brace.
Keeps it a bit shorter of a good length around off, punched off the back foot by Root to mid off.
Tossed up on off, Cooks and kept out well by Cook.
Fuller on off, driven straight to mid on.
Tossed up on off, Cooks defends solidly.
Very full ball on the leg stump from over the wicket. Root sweeps this one to the fielder at deep square leg to get a run.
Tossed up very full on off, Cook leans ahead and smoothly drives to long on for a single.
Tossed up on off, Cook blocks it out.
A bit shorter of good length around off, Cook has tapped towards point to retain strike.
Fuller on the stumps, driven to mid off.

Super shot but just for a single. Bumrah lands this one again on a good length just outside off. Root plays the cover drive on the up and connects well. However, Dhawan at extra cover does well to dive and half-stop it for the batsman to cross over for a single.
On a good length attacking the off stump, Root blocks of the back foot.
Very full, fast and straight. Root drives it to mid off.

Bumrah starts the new over with a short of a length ball in line of the stumps. Root looks to block it from within his crease but gets a thick inside edge. The ball rolls down towards the fine leg region, a bit wide of the fielder there and this allows the English pair to come back for the second run.
BEATEN NOW! Quicker and outside off, Cook goes for the cut but misses.
The batsman has driven it through mid off.

So the around the wicket angle is troubling Cook. An edge earlier and now one almost pops back. Jadeja again fires it on off, it may have stopped in the surface as Cook goes at it with hard hands. The ball lobs back to the right of the bowler but it is a little too far for Jadeja to make an attempt.

EDGY FOUR! This one goes away from the batsman with the angle after pitching on off. Cook tries to defend but the ball takes the outside edge and goes past the diving Rahane at first slip and into the fence.
Tosses it up on middle, Cook pushes it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Timed and timed to perfection! Short and outside off, another poor delivery. Cook punches it through cover-point and the ball races away.
Goes for the yorker but bowls a full toss on middle, Cook works it to fine leg for a run.
Works it with the angle to mid-wicket.
Slightly short and outside off, skids through after pitching. Cook goes for the cut but misses.
A little too straight on middle, Root flicks it down to fine leg for a run.
On a length around middle, Root works it to mid-wicket. Not sure why the new ball has not been taken yet. This ball is doing absolutely nothing.
Fuller in length on middle, Root strokes it to mid on.
Jasprit Bumrah is into the attack.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Worked with the turn to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Short, wide and punished! Cook cashes in on the poor delivery and cuts it through covers for a boundary. 319 is the lead.
Works it through square leg and takes a run.
Root uses his feet but does not get to the pitch of the ball, he drives it to mid off.
On the leg pole, turning away. Root keeps it out.
Shami lands this last ball of the over a bit fuller and around off. Root drives crisply through covers and takes a single to retain strike.
A bit shorter around off from Shami. Cook waits back and punches through covers for an easy single.

Lands it just a bit shorter than a good length, Root tries to push it into the off side but gets it off the thick outer edge of his bat and the ball rolls towards the third man region. The English pair cross for a single.

FOUR! A smashing cover drive! Shami lands this on a good length but a bit wide of off. Root sees the width on it and goes for a flamboyant drive on the up. His timing and placement is superb and the ball races across the deep cover boundary for the crowd to applaud the class of this batsman.
Similar ball but this time the English great whips it off his pads towards mid-wicket. The fielder there misfields, letting the batsmen cross over for a single.
Shami starts off the new over with a short of a length ball around off, from around the stumps and angling into Cook. Cook blocks it out from within the crease.
Flatter outside off, Cook punches it through covers and keeps strike.
Outside off, left alone.
The batsman offers no stroke and gets hit on the pad.
Works it with the turn to mid on.

14th Test ton for Joe Root. No mic-drop celebration this time as he only takes his helmet off and raises his bat to the crowd. A much-needed one for him in Tests as it has come after almost a year. He taps this quicker ball on the off side with soft hands and scampers through for a run. 'ROOOOT' - the stadium erupts in its standard celebration for the English skipper as he completes the milestone.
Eases it down to long on and Cook is now 4 short of 120.
Once again hits the length but the ball goes straight on. Root pushes it to mid off.
On the stumps, Root defends it out.
On a length around off, Root pushes it to covers.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Shortish outside off, Cook pushes it through point and takes a run.

FOUR! Nailed! Slightly short on middle, Cook picks the length early and pulls it through square leg. The sub, Karun Nair, makes good ground to his left, dives but his knee gets stuck into the turf and as a result he cannot stop the ball from crossing the boundary. He is down on his knee, looks like he has injured himself. Let's hope it's nothing serious. This also brings the 200-run partnership up. How many more are they going to add?
Root again brings out the broom and he connects well through square leg for a brace.
Cook again tries to work it with the turn on the leg side but misses to get hit on the pads. The ball rolls towards fine leg and the batsmen take a leg bye.
On off, kept out.
With the turn guides it through point and gets to the other end.
On middle, Root defends it.
Works it with the turn through the leg side for a run.
On a length on off, kept out.
The batsman has driven it through mid on.
Another back of a length delivery on off, Root tries to play it with an angled bat but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Back of a length on off, Root defends it onto the ground.
A bumper down the leg side, Root lets it go through to the keeper.

EDGED AND DROPPED! Another chance goes abegging! Maybe Pant's dive there put Pujara off. Shami still does not have lady luck on his side. This time he induces the edge but is let down by his teammate. He bowls it on a length around off, Root goes after it away from his body. The ball takes the edge and goes to the left of Pujara. Pant does dive for it but gets nowhere close to it. Pujara at first slip, gets two hands to it but spills it. It rolls towards third man and the batsmen take a couple.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
A little too wide outside off, Cook pads it away.
Eases it down to long off and moves onto 94. A biggie away now is Root from a ton.
Fires it on middle, Root defends it onto the ground.
Stays over the wicket to the right-hander. Bowls a friendly full toss, Root fails to put it away and finds the cover fielder with a drive.
One more run through the cover area! Too full and outside off, timed through the off side for a single.
Ravindra Jadeja will bowl from the other end.
On the fuller side again but no swing whatsoever. Root tries to drive but gets it off the inner half towards mid on.
Another trademark Cook cover drive but this time a little too closer to the man at sweeper cover. The batsmen complete one, Root wants a second but is sent back in time by his partner.
FOUR! Crunched! That was right off the middle and that went to the ropes like a tracer bullet. Fuller and outside off, Cook caresses it through the cover region and the ball races away.
Just ahead of a length around off, no swing on offer. Cook pushes it to mid off.
Comes around the wicket and bowls it on a length around off, Cook defends it onto the ground.
A run straightaway! Shami starts off with a bumper on the body of the batsman. Root goes for the pull but mistimes it towards backward square leg for a run.

The Indian players are out in a huddle and now they make their way out to the middle. Alastair Cook and Joe Root make their way out and they would look to continue in the same manner as they did in the first session. Mohammed Shami will start the proceedings. Here we go...
... Day 4, Session 2 ...

The tourists, on the other hand, looked as if they had given up the match from the start of the day's play. Ishant Sharma was changed after just an over due to an injury and Jadeja, who replaced him, was not looking dangerous at all. The English pair of Cook and his skipper were able to score at a fast pace and the Indian bowlers were never allowed to settle in on a tight line and length. How fast and how long will England bat are the main questions at the moment. We will find the answers after the break. Join us soon for the post-Lunch session...

31 overs, 129/0 - a session where runs have flowed! The most expensive one in this game and probably it has taken India out of the Test. However, it will though be remembered more for a century by one of the game's greatest openers, Alastair Cook. He is still unbeaten and along with his captain, who is also on 92, has put his team in a position where they can now look to bat India completely out of this game. A quicker run rate after Lunch would also mean their bowlers will have enough overs left to get 10 Indian wickets.
Flatter delivery outside off, Cook leaves it alone and enters Lunch on Day 4 unbeaten!
Cook tries to whip this off the back foot. This one is a bit quicker. Cook tries to whip it through the leg side but he misses and gets hit on the pads.
Skidder on a bit fuller length outside off. Cook comes forward to block, the ball skids through and beats Cook.

This one is a bit slower and in line with the stumps. Root picked it early and slog sweeps it through the square leg region. An excellent chase and stop by the sub Karun Nair at deep square leg, saving a run for the visitors.
Fuller and wide of off. Root shoulders arms.
Starts the new over with a flatter and a bit shorter delivery on the stumps. Root, from within the crease, defends.
On a good length around off, Cook comes forward to keep it out but the ball moves away on landing and the English opener is beaten.
A bit shorter of a good length around off, tapped towards point to pick up a single.
tries to attack the stumps again but strays a bit too down the leg. Root looks to flick it but misses and Pant collect.

Fires this one very full on the middle and leg line. Root tries to flick it but misses complete;y to get rapped on the pads. The visitors appeal in unison but the umpire turns it down. India don't go for the review and wisely so as Hawk shows the ball would have missed the leg stump by a good margin.

Some T20 thinking by Bumrah. Bowls this off cutter on a good length just outside off. Root is beaten in pace as he looks to come forward to defend but is way to early and is beaten by pace. Pant collects it on the bounce.
Bumrah, from the around the wicket, keeps it shorter in length outside off. Cook guides it towards the third man region off the back foot to pick up another run.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Slower through the air on off, Cook tries to tuck it around the corner on the leg side for a run but gets a leading edge towards point for a run.
He now pushes this through covers and gets to the other end.

FOUR! Swept and swept fine! How well has he played this shot? Full and outside off, Root goes down on one knee and sweeps it through mid-wicket and the ball races away. He moves onto a score which the Australians consider as unlucky.
Quicker outside off, Root guides it to backward point.
Fires it on off, Root defends it.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Good leave! He left that on length I feel. Good length ball around off, Cook shoulders arms to it.
On a length and outside off, left alone.
Similar to the off pole this time. Root guides it down to third man for a run.

BEAUTY! I will tell you why? Firstly, Bumrah goes wide of the crease and angles it in. Now due to that angle, Root has to play at the delivery. He tries to do with a back foot defense. The ball though pitches and then shapes away beating the outside edge of Root.
Goes wide of the crease and bowls it on off, Root defends it onto the ground.
Jadeja fires it quicker but a bit down the leg side.  It hits Cook on his pads. No run there.
Similar ball but a bit outside off. Cook this time drives to mid off.
Fuller on the off stump, Cook drives this straight to mid on.
Jaddu fores this one a bit straighter, Root works it down the leg side towards the square leg region for a single.
Tossed up on off, Root has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Hundred for Alastair Cook in his last Test innings. A special moment for a special player! A feat which even the greatest of greats were not able to achieve. He must have dreamt about this moment and now he's living it. Jadeja keeps it a bit flatter and just outside off, Cook quickly rocks back and cuts this one to the backward point region and sets off for a quick run. The fielder in that region, maybe sensing a run out opportunity, has a shy at the non-striker's end. Jadeja leaves it thinking there is someone backing up but there is nobody. It results in the ball racing to the boundary. That means 5 runs has been added to Cook's total and that in turn means he gets to his century. Cook removes his helmet and soaks in a well-deserved standing ovation from this houseful crowd at The Oval. A proud, proud moment for his family who are present there and an emotional one for him as well. This will go down as a historic moment as he becomes the first ever with two centuries and two fifties in his first and last match. Well played, legend!
Ravindra Jadeja is back on.
On a length around off, Root keeps it out.
That ball has struck the batsman on the thigh pad.

On the pads, Cook works it fine on the leg side. For a moment all my colleagues felt it was a boundary but there was a fielder at fine leg who was very fine specifically for such a shot. So, only a run.
Wide! Banged but too short. Wide given.

FOUR! Classic Cookkie! One of the best of his innings this one. He moves to 95 with this amazing straight drive. Bumrah, looking for some movement, pitches this one a bit fuller than good length around off. Cook comes on the front foot and with a straight bat plays one of the most beautiful shots in the game. The straight drive bisects the fielders at mid off and mid on to races across the boundary.
Fuller and a bit wide of off, Root comes ahead and drives towards mid off and sets off for a quick single. The fielder at mid off has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses the stumps.
Bumrah starts his spell with a length ball on Cook's pads. The left-handed opener flicks it nonchalantly through the fine leg region for a single.
Jasprit Bumrah is back on.
Driven through the covers by the batsman.
On the shorter side, Cook cuts it through point and now he is just 10 short of a ton. What a fairy-tale ending this can be for one of the greatest English batsmen.
Floated it up on off, Cook strokes it to mid off.
WIDE! Way too wide outside off, the umpire has also signaled it one. Not often do you see those in Test matches.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Loopy ball on off, Cook with the turn, strokes it towards covers.
On the shorter side outside off, Root goes back and cuts it towards point for a run.
A leading edge but drops in front of Jaddu. A slower ball landing in the rough and gripping. Cook is early into his shot and as a result, leading edge is induced. No harm done in the end.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
Defends the ball right under his eyes.
Around off, worked to mid on.
Slower, on the same line, pushed to the off side for an easy single.
Fast, in line of the stumps, defended.
Cook has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Byes! Vihari dishes this one a bit flatter but very wide outside off. Cook leaves it alone but Pant behind cannot collect it cleanly as the ball has landed in the rough and bounced a bit more than he might have expected. It hits his gloves and goes behind. Rahane, at slips, tries to stop it but cannot and the batsmen have crossed over for a brace.

Beaten! Vihari tosses this one a little and probably that is exactly why he gets a bit more purchase from the pitch this time. The ball lands, grips a bit and turns away from Cook to beat his forward defense.
Drives this nicely but straight to covers. No run on offer.
Tossed up in line with the stumps, Cook defends off the front foot.
The broom is out again as Root sweeps this fuller length delivery towards square leg region for a single.
Tossed up on off, Cook keeps it out off the front foot.
Flatter and fuller this one outside off. Cook goes back, looking to push it into the off side, but the ball skids through and also keeps a bit low for the ball to beat the outside edge.
Quicker and a bit shorter outside off, Root punches through covers for yet another easy single.
Tossed up on the off stump, Root defends off the front foot.
Flatter and fuller on the stumps, defended off the front foot.
A bit straighter this one, Cook works it down the leg side towards square leg for a single.
Root goes down to sweep this fuller ball outside off, misses the ball as it raps him on the pads, but outside off.
Floated this one fuller on off, Cook drives crisply through covers for a single.
Tossed up on off, blocked out off the front foot by Cook.
A bit fuller from Vihari on off, Cook flicks it against the spin through mid-wicket for a brace.
A slower and a bit shorter on the stumps, Cook comes forward and keeps it out
Tossed up around off. Cook prods forward and defends.
On the pads, flicked through the leg side for another easy single. Jadeja has gone for 5 runs an over this morning. Missing Ashwin now?
Hangs back and works the slower shortish ball off the back foot through the off side and changes strike.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! And he paddles this full ball fine to the fine leg region for second boundary of the over. 200 is up for England as well and Lead up to 240.
Again shortish on the pads, worked to the leg side for a single off the pads. Leg Bye signalled by the umpire.
FOUR! Short and wide and asking to be punished. Jadeja is known to be accurate with his line and length but today, he has been sloppy. Cook goes back and gets it through covers for a boundary.
Change of ends for Jadeja.
Ends his first over of the innings with a fuller one on off. Cook drives it to the fielder at covers
Slower ans shorter outside off, Cook punches this into the cover region for a single.

Pull again but this time against the spinner. Root playing aggressive cricket and looking for quick runs. Vihari fires in a quicker but shorter delivery on the stumps, Root quickly goes back and pulls it towards the deep square leg region for a single.
Vihari drops it a bit shorter in length, Cook goes back and punches it through covers for a single.
Fuller and slower on the stumps, Root goes down on his knee and sweeps it all along the ground to the deep square leg region to add a run to the total.

Vihari bowls his first ball of this innings a slower and just a bit shorter outside off, Root waits for the ball and then opens the bat face very late to guide it towards he third man region to get a brace.
Hanuma Vihari is on now.
Shorter of a length on off, tapped towards point for another single.

FOUR! Cracker of a pull! For all the students of the game - the English skipper shows exactly how you play the shot. Shami bangs it in short, looking to surprise the batsman. But Root is upto the task, as he swivels quickly and gets the pull out. The connection is near perfect as the ball races across the deep square leg boundary.
Beaten! Shami gets the ball to move out after landing it on a length around off. Root looks to tentatively keep it out but gets beaten by the outward movement. That is a rare miss we have seen today.
Good yorker but well dug out by Root as he gets his bat down just in time.
Keeps it a bit shorter outside off, Cook punches it through covers to take a single.
Good length outside off, left alone by Cook.
Jaddu lands this wide of off, Root shoulders arms.
Full on off, defended off the front foot.

SIX! That is wonderful from the English skipper, shows how confident he is feeling in the middle now. Jadeja tosses this one in line of the stumps, Root dances down the track and lofts it, through the line, straight over the bowler's head. The timing is supreme and the ball lands in the stands. He is looking to stamp his authority and up the ante as well. Ominous signs these for India!
Flatter and straighter, Cook whips it towards square leg to exchange strike.
Tossed up and defended off the front foot.
Very full on off, Root drives through covers for a single.
Wide off off, left alone by Cook.
Fires this on his pads, flicked to square leg for yet another single.

Well bowled! Shami fire this on on off, keeps it on a length and gets the ball to shape into Cook. The left hander looks to push it into the cover region but the inward movement takes the inside edge and rolls towards square leg. They take another single. Another milestone for Cook, what a servant he has been of this wonderful sport. He goes past Kumar Sangakara to become the 5th highest run scorer in Test history.
Strays on Root's pads, Joe flicks it for a single to the fine leg region.
Bumper again, Cook goes for the pull, is a bit too early into it. The ball takes the bottom edge and rolls towards point and the batsmen have taken a single.
Leg bye! Lands this on a length on middle. The ball nips in on pitching. Root tries to flick it but gets rapped on the pads and the ball deflects into the leg side. They run a single.

Time for the first drinks break on Day 4. A very good first hour for the home side. They have added 55 runs today in a matter of 15 overs and that too without losing any wickets. The Indian bowlers though have not looked penetrating at all. The pitch has flattened out as well. Can the visitors come back after the break or will the wheels keep on rolling? We shall find out soon, after the break...
Tossed up around off, Defended off the front foot.
Fuller and slower through the air, just outside off, Root drives in the gap at covers to pick up a single.
A bit quicker this one, Root goes back but gets his bat down very late to keep it out.
A bit slower and shorter in length. Root punches it towards the covers.
Very full on off, Root drives but straight to extra cover.
Jaddu starts his new over with a shorter length delivery outside off, Cook goes back and cuts it to deep square leg to change strike.

FOUR! Fifty for Root and he gets there in style! His 42nd in this format. A much-needed one for him and it has been a very fluent fifty. A freebie to get there, short and width on offer outside off. He pounces on it and cuts it through point for a boundary.
On off, pushed to mid off.

Howzzat? The answer to that question is not out! An inswinger, something which he has ben vulnerable against. He goes for the flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The players appeal and the umpire shakes his head. Missing leg and the Hawk Eye confirms it.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
On middle, Cook tries to work it on the leg side but gets an inside edge, It then hits him on his pads and then goes towards point for a run.
On the shorter side, Root cuts it through point for a run. This also brings up the 100-run stand. This partnership is also taking the game away from India.

A muted appeal but not given! Jadeja floats it up on off, it turns back in. Cook plants his front foot outside the line and tries to defend but the ball hits his pads and goes into the hands of silly point.
Flatter on off, Cook lunges and keeps it out.
The lead is now above 200! Slightly shorter in length and outside off, Cook waits for it and guides it through backward point for a brace.
That's hit the batsman on his pads.

DROPPED! A sharp chance but you expect Rahane to take those. Well, you can excuse Rahane there as that came really quickly. Once again, Root tries to play it very late as he rocks back and tries to cut. Not an easy shot to play against Jadeja. Root almost pays the price as he edges it. The ball flies to the right of Rahane at first slip. The ball hits his hands and rolls towards short third man. A run taken. India need these to stick if they are to have any hope in this game.
Floats it up on off, Root strokes it to mid off.
On the pads, Cook fails to put it away. A scoring opportunity goes abegging.
Goes around the wicket to the southpaw and bowls it on off, Cook pushes it to mid on.
Back of a length outside off, Root punches it through point and takes a run.
Down the leg side, Root misses the flick and Pant collects it.
On the stumps, Root defends it.
Slightly fuller on off, Cook strokes it through covers for a run.
Mohammed Shami is into the attack.
FOUR! Second boundary in the over! Again, he goes down on one knee and sweeps it through mid-wicket. No stopping it and Root is 5 shy of a half ton. A much-needed one.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
On the stumps, Root lunges and keeps it out.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! It looks just too easy at the moment! Jadeja bowls it outside off, Root plants his front foot down and sweeps it through square leg for a boundary.
Runs again! The lead is now upto 188. Nicely timed this. Jadeja tosses it up on off, Root times it through covers for a brace.
Again solid from Cook. He looks very determined today and the crowd is applauding every run he scores. Slightly fuller on off, Cook strokes it through covers and takes two.
Another length ball around off, Cook is solid in defense.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Back of a length outside off, Cook shoulders arms to it.
Top shot and equally well fielded. Full and on off, Cook strokes it through covers. Jadeja, from deep backward point, runs to his left and keeps it down to two.
On a length around off, Root tucks it around the corner on the leg side and takes a run.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman. So, no real turn seen for Jadeja, despite the rough marks outside off.
Works it with the turn to short leg.
On the stumps and Cook pushes it back to the bowler.
Easy again as the length is way too short. Root goes back and plays it to sweeper cover for a run. The lead has now crossed 180.
Quicker and on off, Cook pushes it through covers and takes a run.

FOUR! No Jadeja, you just brought in an extra catcher but then you bowl a short ball outside off. Easy pickings for Cook, he goes back and cuts it through point for a boundary. he now becomes the second most run-getter against India in Tests, going past Clive Lloyd. Ricky Pointing has the most - 2555. Don't think he will breaking that record.
A silly point in place now. India looking for wickets here.
A rib-tickler to end the over. Root plays it down well.
A yorker, which I feel he should bowl quite consistently in the longer format. Root manages to dig it out.
Driven through mid on by the batsman.
On a length around off, Cook confidently pushes it to mid off for a run.

On a length outside off, Cook does not play at it. His confidence and concentration surely won't be rattled even after bombarding him with a lot of short balls. A reason why he is considered as one of the greats.
Certainly a plan this from India. Another short ball outside off, Cook goes for the pull but gets a bottom edge to the keeper. This tactic maybe because the ball ain't doing as much.
Root has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery. End of a tight over by Jadeja. However, wickets is what India need.
Pushes this against the turn through the off side for a run.

BEATEN! Clever bowling, he bowls it quicker and a touch fuller. Cook misreads the length and goes back to defend it. He also plays for the non-existent turn. His outside edge is beaten as the ball goes straight on.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Fires this one just outside off, expecting some vicious turn out of the rough. Does not get any and Cook blocks it easily.
A little too short on off, Cook has all the time in the world to rock back and defend it.
Goes for a similar delivery but this time he starts it from the leg pole. Cook goes back and guides it towards point for a run.
Excellent delivery! Very good use of the angle there. On a length and around off, it pitches and slants across the batter. Cook has a feel for it but gets beaten.

Another bye! However, Pant is not to be blamed this time. Good captaincy though by Kohli as he has his fine leg really fine. Bumrah delivers another short ball on the body of the batsman. Root ducks out of the way. The ball moves away further giving no chance to Pant and the batsmen run a bye.
Good change in length! Bowls it fuller this time, the only thing missing there was some movement and hence, Root easily defends it out.
Another bumper but this one bounces a little too much. Cook misses the pull, Pant, behind the stumps, fails to collect it cleanly and concedes a bye.

A snorter there by Bumrah! He has bowled quite a few bumpers till now but this is the best of the lot. Maybe he is doing so as Root is standing outside the crease. The bounce gets big on Joe as he tries to fend it. The ball hits the splice of the bat and goes uppishly towards gully. No fielder there so a run results.
Slower and fuller on the stumps, the English opener flicks it to mid-wicket to end Jaddu's maiden over.
A bit flatter on middle, Cook prods forward and keeps it out.
Very full outside off, Cook drives crisply but straight to the fielder at mid off.
Tossed up on off, defended.
A bit slower and shorter this one, Cook waits a bit longer and blocks it with a straight bat.
Starts the new over with a very full delivery on off. Cook comes forward and blocks.
Another bumper but again Root evades it with ease. So, two dots to end the over.
Another bouncer but it comes off the wicket quite slowly. Root easily ducks under it.
On the shorter side outside off, Root watches it go through to the keeper.
A solid punch but only for a run. Back of a length on off, Cook pushes it towards mid off and takes a quick single. The lead is now 169.
A little too wide outside off, Cook does not play at it.
Pitches it on a length and on middle, Cook defends it onto the ground.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

How deft was that! Always risky to play this against Jadeja due to the pace he bowls at. RJ darts it around off, Root goes back, waits for the ball and then guides it through short third man for a brace.
On the stumps, kept out.
Fires it outside off, Cook prods forward and tries to defend. The ball this time turns back in sharply, hits his pads and rolls towards the off side. The batsmen run a leg bye.

FOUR! This time it is a touch too full, the spin is out of contention as Cook reaches to the pitch of the delivery and strokes it through covers. No stopping that and runs coming thick and fast for England this morning.
Fires it on off, Cook lunges and blocks it out. Not a lot of turn on the first delivery for Jadeja.
Ravindra Jadeja is into the attack.
That stays a touch low or maybe Root just misjudged the length. On the shorter side on middle, it comes back in. Root goes for the pull but misses to get hit near the box.
Third bouncer in the over by Bumrah, Root though spots it early and ducks under it.
Changes strike with this one as Bumrah bowls it on a length around off, Cook pushes it to wide mid off and scampers through.
Another one, this time though it is a well-directed one. Cook goes for the pull but is beaten by pace.
A bumper down the leg side, Cook lets it go.

FOUR! Fifty for Cook, his 58th in Tests. He is bowing out in some style, consecutive fifties for him. This time though, he would want to convert it into a big one and if he does so, it will be the 7th ton against India, which will be his most against any team in Tests. He has the time and he is also looking good out there. He gets a gift to get to his milestone. On the pads, that is one place you do not want to bowl to him. He flicks it through square leg and the ball races away. He raises his bat and soaks in the applause from the crowd.
Jasprit Bumrah will bowl from the other end.
Fuller in length on off, Root strokes it to mid off.
BEATEN! Root looks like he has come out in an aggressive mode! A length ball outside off, Root would have probably left that alone on any other day but he goes for it and gets beaten.

First run for Cook today! Should have been two there but these two aren't the quickest between the wickets. Ishant lands it on a length around middle, this one goes on with the angle. Cook tries to defend but the ball goes off the inner half towards square leg for only a run.
England are underway! Ishant once again gets appreciable movement from outside off, it comes back in. Root guides it through point and takes a run.
Another inswinger but the line is down the leg side. Ishant is probably trying to hit Root's pads. However, this time it misses everything and Pant, behind the stumps, collects it.
Some swing for the tall fast bowler as the ball tails back in from outside off. Root takes a step or two ahead, maybe to cover the swing and blocks it quite confidently.

We are all set for the action to get underway. Out come Alastair Cook, who walks out with the bat for probably the final time in Test cricket. He gets a huge round of applause from the crowd as he makes his way in the middle. Joe Root walks alongside him and the two will resume their innings. The English skipper will be on strike and he will face Ishant Sharma who will start the proceedings. Here we go...
Pitch report - Sanjay Manjrekar says it looks similar to what it was on Day 3. Informs there is rough on both the sides, which should probably assist the spinners.

England, currently, are placed in a dominant position and will look to build on their lead. Their aim will be to bat the Indians out of the game but also give enough time to their bowlers to bowl them out. What lies in store for us? We will find out in the all-important first session itself. Stay tuned.

Hello and welcome to the fourth day of the final Test between England and India at The Oval. The visitors start Day 4 not very different to where they stood at the start of Day 3, looking to crawl their way back into this Test. A day when the tourists will need to raise their game and try to make early breakthroughs before the match starts to slip away from their hands.
... Day 4, Session 1 ...

So, this Test match once again gets tilted in England's favour. Batting last won't be easy on this pitch. The visitors have their backs to the wall even after putting up a brave performance in the first two sessions today. The Indian bowlers have tried hard, in fact too hard, but sometimes you need luck on your side as well. Plenty of times they beat the bat but failed to induce the edges. Let's see how Day 4 pans out. Do join us at 1100 local (1000 GMT) for all the action. Cheers!

Ravindra Jadeja, who is up for an interview, says it is all about pride and that is what they are playing for now. Adds further that he looked to play his normal game and it went well for him. Mentions that it was very tough playing the English bowlers but he tried battling it out for as long as possible. Admits after a long time he played a long innings and hence, he was suffering from cramps. States Test cricket is the real test and he is happy to play well. Tells that the plan with Bumrah was to play four balls and then look for a single. Reckons bowling quicker on this wicket is more helpful. Ends by saying that they hope to restrict England around 250.

Just like the English lower order, the Indian lower order also wagged. Ravindra Jadeja and Hanuma Vihari showed a lot of resilience in the morning session as they raised a 77-run stand. Post that, Jadeja counter-attacked and reduced the deficit down to 40. In reply, as has been the norm, Keaton Jennings got out cheaply but the tourists failed to open the floodgates. Moeen Ali added a little partnership with Alastair Cook and then Joe Root took it forward.

Huge roar from the crowd as Alastair Cook and Joe Root leave the field. England will be delighted at the moment. They have extended their lead to 154 for the loss of only two wickets. The hosts started the day's play in front and have ended it that way as well. Although, in between they had to grind hard.
It's wide outside off, Root keeps it out towards point and takes a single. That will be it. Stumps on Day 3.
One ball to go...
Conventional run-up this time. On a length and outside off, a solid push off the front foot by Root.

Slight change of angle now. Bumrah runs in straight, behind the umpire and then at the last moment pops out, a bit like Bob Willis quips Nasser Hussain on air. Goes wide of the crease and bowls it wide outside off. Root leaves it alone.
Shortish and outside off, Root gets across the stumps and plays it down to gully.
Bumrah gets greedy. Tries repeating the last delivery from the middle stump line but ends up bowling it too straight. Cook clips it off his pads to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Play and a miss! Bumrah from 'round the wicket takes a full delivery away from the left-hander. Cook pushes at it and gets beaten.
Whoa! Skidding in with extra bounce around off. Root goes back to cut but is cramped for room. Misses the ball and it goes over the stumps. Risky!
Keeps darting it in. Full and on middle, defended on the leg side.
Fires a full ball on off, Root draws forward and defends it back.
Short this time, outside off, Root plays a back foot cut but once again finds short third man.
Quicker and fuller on off, Root pushes it with an angled bat to short third man.
Leans forward to a full ball and defends it to the off side.
Four byes! Poor Pant having a tough time. Way wide outside off, keeps on going further with the movement, Pant tries collecting it with a dive but fails. 50-run stand comes up. Lead also crosses 150!
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Lands it on a length and outside off, Root gets forward and pushes it with gentle hands to point.
Angling away from the batsman, Cook leans forward and pushes it in the gap at covers for a run.
Too wide outside off, Cook has an easy leave.

Sharp delivery, on a good length and down the leg side, Cook is beaten for pace as he tries to flick. He is hit on the pads, they appeal mutely but nothing doing. A cry of desperation more than anything.
Width on offer outside off, Cook plays late and wide of backward point for one.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Fires one on middle and leg, Cook flicks it to mid-wicket.
Stifled appeal for an lbw! Jadeja bowls it on off and gets it to spin back in. Cook fails to flick and is hit a bit high on his pads. The impact too seemed to be outside off.
Gets on the front foot to a full ball and forces it down towards mid on.
Tossed up ball on off, Cook defends it with a big lunge.
Ravindra Jadeja is back on.
There is certainly extra life and venom in this ball. Bumrah serves it wide outside off, it lands and shoots off the surface. Root has nothing to do with it. A good carry to the keeper.
Two men dropped back on the leg side hinting that Bumrah will bowl short. But this one is on a length outside off and Root defends it down safely.

FOUR! Beautifully picked up off his pads. Almost similar to the last delivery. Moving back into the batsman from outside off, Root shimmies down the track a bit and flicks it superbly to the deep square leg fence.
Straightaway big movement. Length ball landing around off and jagging back in sharply. Root gets across in an attempt to flick but misses. It goes behind and it's a good take by Pant.
And again! Issues with the shape of the ball. Poor quality Duke balls? The umpires have called for replacement. Last time this happened, India picked a wicket next ball. What will happen this time?
Angles in a good length ball on off, Root covers the line and defends it right under his watchful eyes.
Full and outside off, Root drives it on the up but finds the cover fielder.
Shami runs in from 'round the wicket and angles in a length ball on off. Cook blocks it solidly to end the over. Around 20 minutes more left in the day's play and six overs to be bowled. Hmm...
Lands it on a full length outside off, Root pushes it with an angled bat through point and hurries across to the other end.
A pitched up delivery around off, Root slices his drive a bit to the off side. Finds the mid off fielder.
Good length ball on off, Root defends it off his back foot.

FOUR! Shot of the evening! This time his head was right on top of the delivery. Full and around off, Root presents a straight bat as he unfurls a fabulous drive down the ground for a boundary. England racing away here and India are lacking intensity in the field.

EDGY FOUR! Runs are coming thick and fast. Shami serves a delivery in the channel outside off. It's on a length and Root is sucked into a cover drive. He doesn't account for the movement and edges it behind. Luckily for him it goes wide of the slip cordon for a boundary.

Full and angling into the batsman, Root leans forward and across before flicking it wide of mid on. Once again his head fell a bit too much across as has been the case with him of late. A single taken.
Slants in a length ball on off, Root stays back, allows it to come at him and then defends it stoutly.
Once again the line is too straight and it's easy-peasy for Cook. He turns it in the gap in front of square leg to pick up a run.

Length delivery on middle and off, Cook gets across and tickles it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs. Kohli has a wry smile on his face after watching Ishant Sharma getting to the ball. He was a bit lazy there. Possibly tired.
Zipping across the surface. It's around off and angling away from the batsman. Cook stays his ground and allows it through. The artificial lights are on and it might help the Indian bowlers.
Lands it on a length and on middle, Cook gets a bit squared up as he pushes it off the outside half of his blade to point.
A hint of inward movement back into the batsman. First signs of reverse? Maybe. It's full and around off, Root presents a straight bat and keeps it out off the inner half. It rolls to mid on.
A touch short and around off, it's angled in, Cook stays back and works it in the gap at mid-wicket for one.
Gets on the front foot to a delivery angled into him and pushes it out to covers.
Slightly short in length and outside off, Cook goes on the back foot and taps it down to covers.
Pitches it up and outside off, Root drives it on the up towards extra cover for a run.
Shami starts from 'round the wicket angle but his line is too straight. Cook eases it through mid-wicket and takes a single.
Here comes Mohammed Shami for another spell.
Straighter delivery, Cook flicks it off the inner half of his bat to square leg. A single taken. Lead is now 125.
Beauty from Bumrah! Bumrah takes this delivery away from the southpaw, Cook is lured into the drive and is beaten. Good take by Pant.
Back of a length ball on off, Cook goes on his toes and defends it to the off side.
Mohammed Shami seems to be stretching. Might see him soon into the attack.
Bowls it around middle and off, Cook covers the line and defends it off his front foot.
Good length ball around off, angling away, Cook remains on the back foot and defends it with gentle hands to the off side.
Pitches it full and on off, Cook plays a punchy drive down the ground but finds the mid off fielder.
Flighted and outside off, Root defends it nicely.
Tossed up ball on off, Cook flicks it a bit aerially past short leg for a run.
Once again AC is forward with a big stride as he meets the ball before defending it to the off side.
Full flighted ball landing outside off, Cook lunges and defends it watchfully.
Turning back into the batsman from outside off, Cook stays back footed as he defends.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
This time Cook jumps on his back foot and works it in the gap on the leg side. Another run.
Fuller and straighter, Cook picks the scoring chance and eases it through mid-wicket for a brace.
More assured this time by Cook. He covers the line of the delivery and defends it from the back foot.
Testing over! Bumrah angles this across the batsman, Cook pokes inside the line and misses. One can smell a wicket here. Top stuff by Jasprit.
Movement back into the batsman, Root gets an inside edge onto the pads as he comes across the stumps. It deflects to covers and they steal a run.
Edged but safe! Full length ball around middle and off, Cook closes the face of his bat and gets a leading edge. It goes safely towards point though. The fielder is in the deep and a run is taken.
Spinning down towards leg, Cook works it across, finds the gap on the on side and collects a single.
Shortish outside off, played down to point.
Tossed up ball outside off, Cook fails to defend and is hit on the pads. Appeal is made but the impact is outside off.

In the air... Kohli sprints across to his right from leg gully, puts in a full length dive, catches the ball but as his hand hits the ground, it comes out. No, not a dropped catch. You know why? Because there wasn't any edge. Coming to the delivery, it spun back into the batsman who tried to flick but missed. The ball had ballooned off his thigh pad. A momentary excitement.
Goes on the back foot and punches it to backward point for one.
Nearly drags it on! Sharp spin back into the batsman from outside off, Cook tries to drive but gets an inside edge past the stumps. A single taken.

On a length and outside off, Root dabs it down towards gully. Rahane picks it up on one bounce and immediately scores a direct hit at the striker's end. No harm done though as Joe never left the crease.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, Root gets across a bit before making a leave.
Angling into the batsman, Root takes his front leg forward and across, away from the line of the sticks, as he defends it towards mid on.
Back of a length ball outside off, Joe keeps his weight on the back foot and taps it down in front of the gully fielder.
Excellent delivery, beating Root all ends up. An inswinger landing on a length outside off, Root walks forward to play at it but it stays low and whizzes past the inside edge of his bat.
Straighter in line first up, Cook works it through mid-wicket and picks up three runs.
Jasprit Bumrah to operate now.
A front foot defense by Root to complete the over. A couple of boundaries coming from it.
Fires this one in. Flatter and on off, Root defends it at the last moment off his back foot.
That's more like it from Jadeja. Drawing the batsman forward by bowling it full and around off. Root mistimes his drive.
FOUR! Once again the length is short and Root cashes in. He rocks back immediately and hammers it past the point fielder. The English skipper is off and running in style.
Flighted ball around off, a bit short again, Root goes back and defends.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Jadeja drops it short and wide outside off, Root loves it there. He goes deep inside the crease and whacks it through point for a cracking boundary.
Full and outside off, shaping away, Cook is very watchful currently as he makes a leave.
Good length ball on middle and leg, going down with the angle, Cook fails to glance and is hit on the thigh pad.
Tries to tempt the batsman by bowling it on a driving length outside off. Cook lets it be and it nips away off the pitch while going to the keeper.
Switches to 'round the wicket and angles in a full ball on off, Cook defends it solidly by getting half-forward.
Again too wide outside off to bother Alastair Cook.
Slants a length ball wide outside off, Cook offers no shot.
Shorter again, Root goes back and cuts it through backward point for a couple. He's off the mark.
A touch flat and short outside off, Root stays back footed as he defends it to the off side.
Skipper Joe Root is in next. He bagged a duck in the first innings and will be keen to get off the mark first up. England are effectively 102/2.

OUT! Bowled 'em! The changed ball brings luck for Jadeja as he pegs the middle stump back. Another delivery which lands in the rough around off and turns back in sharply. Moeen gets on the front foot to drive it but misses the ball completely. It sneaks through the gap between bat and pad and shatters the stumps. The Indians are ecstatic. The 35-run stand has been broken.

Once again some issues with the ball. They already changed it once a few overs back but India were not at all happy. This time the umpires feel that it has lost its shape and have called for the replacement.
Turning back in from around off and Ali defends it on the leg side.
There's the turn. This one perhaps lands on the rough outside off and turns back in with sharp bounce. Moeen stays back to defend and does so with a little bit of discomfort.
Tossed up ball outside off, Cook reaches out for it with a drive and places his shot through covers. Pujara chases it down near the rope and they collect three runs. Lead crosses 100 now.

Drinks break. Unlike the last two days, there hasn't been a flurry of wickets in the last session. Although the session started with England losing Keaton Jennings. Another highlight of the evening's play has been India wasting both their reviews inside 12 overs. Their bowlers are trying hard, beating the edges and causing trouble to the Englishmen but so far have managed only one wicket. A minimum of 17 overs still left in the day's play, let's see which team ends on top.
Bowls it on the pads and Cook eases it through square leg for one. The lead is one short of 100.
Back of a length ball angling away from the batsman, Cook gets on his toes as he plays it down to covers.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Angling away from the batsman, Cook stays back to cover his stumps and then allows it through to the keeper.
Sliding down the leg side, Moeen nudges it to fine leg and rotates the strike.
Bowls it in line of the stumps, Moeen defends it by getting right behind it.
Floated one landing full outside off, Cook strides forward in defense.
This one is a little too full by Jadeja and Moeen sweeps it through backward square leg for a run.
Spin and bounce into Moeen who somehow manages to keep it out safely.
Leans forward and knocks it wide of mid on for a quick run.
Flatter this time, it's on the shorter side as it turns back in, Cook defends it from the back foot.
Flighted and full outside off, Cook gets forward and across before defending it back to the bowler.
Serves it on a length just outside off, Moeen covers the line and defends it to the off side.
On the leg stump line this time, a length ball, Moeen defends it off his pads.
Another fuller length ball on off has been defended watchfully by Moeen.
Pitches it full again, just outside off, Ali defends it off his front foot.

EDGED AND DROPPED! It's FOUR also! Sharma delivers an overpitched delivery outside off, Moeen goes for a big booming cover drive but gets a fat outside edge behind. It flies to KL Rahul at second slip who tries to grab it in front of his face but fails to hold on. It bursts through his hangs and races behind for a boundary. KL has been so good with his catching in the series and must be upset with himself.
Full in length and around off, Moeen keeps it out safely to covers.
Nudges it around the corner with the turn for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fires it outside off again, Cook pushes it towards covers and takes a run. The 50 is up and the lead is 90 now.
Flatter outside off, Cook defends it.
A little too wide outside off, left alone.
Tosses it up on off, Cook defends it.
Attacks the stumps, Moeen gets behind the line and defends it.
Just behind a length outside off, Moeen makes a leave.
Good length again outside off, left alone.
On the pads, Moeen tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. A huge appeal follows by the slip cordon but nothing from the bowler. It was slipping down.
Bowls it on a length again around off, looking to take it away from the left hander but no swing. Moeen defends.
Good length around off, Moeen blocks it.
Ishant Sharma is back on.
Darts it on off, Cook prods forward and defends it.
Works it with the turn towards mid-wicket for a run.
Uses his feet but Jadeja sees that, he shortens the length and Ali can only defend it.
Flatter on off, kept out.
Outside off, left alone.
Tosses it up, Moeen pushes it to mid on.
FOUR! Not this full as he is driven crisply through mid on and the ball races away,. A good over for England, 10 from it.

He beats the inside edge, he beats the outside edge, he gets the edge but just not getting another wicket. Another brute of a delivery. On off and it jags back in, Moeen is cut into half as the ball goes over the stumps. Pant behind fails to collect and a bye is taken. Needs to be a touch fuller Shami.
On a length around off, Moeen keeps it out.

FOUR! In the air... but in the gap! There were a few fielders there but the way Shami's luck is running, that was never going to go to hand. Full and outside off, Moeen goes for the full-blooded drive but the ball takes the outside edge and flies through gully for a boundary.
The awayswinger this time outside off, Moeen goes for the drive but the ball whizzes past the outside edge.
Well bowled and well played! On a length and around off, this one stays a touch low. Cook gets his bat down in time and works it through mid-wicket for a run.
How nonchalant was that? Moeen steps down the track and whips it over mid-wicket. The outfield is a touch slow and hence it does not cross the fence. A couple.
Pushes it towards wide mid on for a run.
Outside off again, Cook plants his front foot outside the off pole and goes for the sweep. He misses, the ball hits him on the pads and the players appeal but the umpire shakes his head.
Fires it on off, Cook pushes it back to the bowler.
Very full outside off, Cook goes for the sweep but misses.
He is welcomed back with a run as Moeen eases it down to long on.
Ravindra Jadeja is back on.
Ohhzz and ahhzz all around as the bat's edge is once again beaten. Just ahead of a length outside off, Cook goes for the drive but is beaten.
On the stumps, kept out.

This is why experience is the key! All those plays and misses is not playing on Cook's mind. He gets a scoring opportunity and ensures he puts it away, not to the fence but for a brace. Slightly short and width on offer outside off, Alastair punches it through covers and takes two. First runs for Cook in this session.
Lovely! Again that angle means Cook has to play but the straightening of the ball beats the outside edge. Not much you can do about that.
Just behind a length on off, Cook pushes it to covers.
Fuller in length on off, Cook opes the face of the bat and guides it to point.
Around off, Moeen guides it to point. Another maiden, Bumrah's fourth in the 5 overs he has bowled.
This one comes back in after pitching. The length though is a touch short and hence Moeen has time to adjust. He tucks it to mid-wicket.
Accurately hits the length around off, Moeen patiently defends it.
Tight line there again. On off, Moeen is solid in defense.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
