Pitches it around off and gets it to straighten, also bounce. Moeen tries to block but the ball hits the splice of the bat.

The sucker ball almost did the trick! Full and wide outside off, Cook's eyes must have lit up as he would have sensed a scoring opportunity. He goes for a drive but is beaten. Another maiden, third in a row.
This one goes on with the angle on off and hence Cook defends it.
Goes even wider of the crease and bowls it full on middle, Cook pushes it back to the bowler.
BEATEN AGAIN! Once again it is that around the wicket channel which is making Cook play as it is angled in. Then it straightens and Cook's bat's outside edge is beaten.
A little too wide to make a batsman of Cook's caliber play at.
BEATEN AGAIN! Not sure whether Cook needed to play at this delivery. It was outside off, Cook has a poke at it and gets beaten.
Bowls it on off, Moeen is solid in defense. A maiden by Bumrah.
Shortish again on middle, Moeen defends it onto the ground.
Nicely bowled! On a length and around off, it pitches and moves away. Moeen first goes to play at it but then pulls his bat back.
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone.
Down the leg side, Moeen misses the flick and Pant collects it behind the stumps.
The slower ball first up outside off, Moeen lets it be.
Jasprit Bumrah is back on.
Just ahead of a length on off, Cook lunges and defends it to covers.
Back of a length on off, Cook punches it to mid on.
On the stumps, Cook works it to mid-wicket.
Outside off, Cook leaves it.
Lovely stuff! Good length around off, it again straightens. Cook goes back and tries to defend but gets beaten.
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman.
BEATEN! He fires this outside off, it goes on with the arm. Moeen plays for the turn and gets beaten as there is none.
Flatter on off, Moeen defends it.
Floats it up on off, MA pushes it back to the bowler.
FOUR! That is Moeen's go-to shot! He gets down on one knee and sweeps it hard through square leg and the ball races away. Played with the spin and all along the ground, in full control.
Tosses it up on off, Moeen defends it.
Off the mark is Ali, on a length, Moeen taps it towards covers for a run.
On off, Ali prods forward and keeps it out.
Moeen Ali is the new man in.

OUT! TIMBER! There are two types of leaves in cricket, a good one and a bad one and that was a bad one. Shami, however, won't mind as he gets a well-deserved wicket. He comes steaming in from around the wicket and lands his inswinger outside off. It comes back in sharply. Jennings offers no shot without covering his stumps much. The ball kisses the top of off and Jennings has to take the long walk back, cheaply again. An early wicket after the break, exactly what India needed.
Back of a length around off, Jennings keeps it out.
Fuller on off, stroked to mid off.
A little too wide outside off, left alone.

NOT OUT! And that is the case, impact is way outside off. India have lost both their reviews inside 15 overs. It is a poor, poor one. Jadeja bowls it flatter and outside off, it pitches and turns back in sharply. Cook goes back and tries to defend but is beaten by the turn. The ball hits him on his pads and the players appeal. The umpire shakes his head. Kohli gives it a thought and goes for the review. Replays show the umpire once again made a correct decision.
Review time! Another shout for an LBW has been denied. Kohli again goes for the review. Impact looks outside off.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fires it on off, Cook pushes it back to the bowler.
On the stumps, worked to mid-wicket.
Play and a miss! Quick and short outside off, Cook goes back and tries to cut but he misses.
Tosses it up on off, Cook defends it onto the ground.
A little too wide outside off, left alone.
On a length around off, KJ is solid in defense. Looking good here is Jennings, probably the best he has looked in this series.

FOUR BYES! That was quick there by Shami. Ufff! Bends his back on this one and bowls it on off, it skids through. Jennings tries to defend but gets beaten. Pant is not sure on how to collect the ball, he fails to do so and the ball races to the fine leg fence.
Fuller in length than the last delivery. Keaton lunges and blocks it out.
Back of a length on off, Jennings defends it onto the ground.
On a length outside the off pole. Jennings shoulders arms.
Mohammed Shami to bowl from the other end.
Jadeja again is on the shorter side outside off, Jennings hits it wide of the cover fielder for a run.
Short and around off, Jennings does well to punch it out.
Once again Keaton brings out the sweep shot and this time succeeds in making connection. It speeds wide of leg slip and they collect a brace,
This time Jennings defends it with the spin to the leg side.

Not out! The impact indeed is outside off. Jadeja tosses this one up and lands a full ball outside off. It spins back in after hitting the deck as Keaton opts for the sweep shot. He though fails to connect and is rapped on the pads. They put in an unsuccessful appeal. Kohli consults his bowler who tells that there was no bat and then his keeper also is confident. India take the DRS but the replays find that the point of impact outside off. A review wasted.

Shout for an lbw. Keaton Jennings has missed his sweep shot and is thudded on the pads. The umpire turns down the appeal and Kohli takes the DRS after consulting his bowler and the keeper. Is impact outside off?
Tossed up ball on off, Jennings stays back and defends it.
We're back for the final session. So far, 11 wickets have fallen in the evening so far in this Test. A minimum of 35 overs left in the day's play. Ravindra Jadeja to begin proceedings.
... DAY 3, THIRD SESSION ...

So, the England openers have batted out the nervy period and end the afternoon session unscathed. A session I believe both teams will be happy with. India, courtesy Jadeja, have not given away a big lead. England, because they have a decent advantage and their openers have begun well. However, we still have one more session to go and it is that time of the day where wickets have fallen the most in this Test. The away side will surely want that to happen whereas the home side will look to build on the lead. Join us for the final session in a short while.
Defended solidly this time. A huge round of applause from the crowd as Cook pushes it to covers. THAT WILL BE TEA ON DAY 3!
BEATEN! Third time in a row! Cook though just has to put all this behind and look forward. Again it pitches on off and straightens. Cook tries to defend but the ball beats the outside edge.

Close shave! Luck is just not favoring Shami in this game. Another top nut. Full and around off, it again first angles into the batsman and then leaves him. Cook tries to push at it but the ball whizzes past the outside edge.
BEAUTY! He bowls it again on a length around off and gets it to straighten. Cook has to play at it as it is angled into him but is beaten by the away movement.
A confident punch there but only a run! Shorter in length outside off, Jennings pushes it through covers and takes a run.
Cook with the angle works it to square leg for a run.
Again on the stumps, Keaton blocks it out easily.
That is where I am talking about. Also the pace is quite slower. He tosses it up outside off, this one grips and turns into the batsman. Jennings tries to defend but gets hit on the body.
On middle, Cook flicks it through square leg for a run. Bowling a little too straight is Jadeja, the rough is just outside the off stump.
Tucks it to short leg with the turn.
On the pads, Jennings this time flicks it away from the fielder at leg slip and takes a run.
Flatter on off, Jennings goes back and blocks it.
Ravindra Jadeja is into the attack.
Hits the deck hard on off, Cook defends it onto the ground. So, a good second half to the over from Shami.
The outswinger now! Testing stuff from the pacer! On a length around off, Cook hangs his bat out only to get beaten.

A huge appeal but not given! Shami shortens his length and bowls it around off, it comes back in. Cook lunges and tries to defend but the ball hits him on the pads and lobs towards Pant. The Indians first start appealing for an LBW and then for a catch after Pant takes it but the umpire shakes his head for both. Impact was outside off.
FOUR! Expensive start for Shami here. Cook gets another ball on his pads. Bread and butter stuff for him. He flicks it through mid-wicket and the ball races away.
Bowls it slightly fuller this time, easier for Cook to caress it through covers. Not for a boundary but two valuable runs.

What does he do first up, something he did many a times in the first innings. BEAT THE OUTSIDE EDGE! Starts off with a ball just ahead of a length. Cook plants his front foot forward and goes for the drive but does not connect.
Mohammed Shami is on.
Gets this one to straighten a touch after pitching on off, Cook is squared up as he tries to defend. The ball rolls towards point and the batsmen take a run. 50 is the lead now.
Pitches it around off, Cook tries to defend but gets it off the inner half towards mid on.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
On a length around off, Cook is solid in defense.
Good length on off, Cook guides it towards point.
Three runs! A little too straight and Ishant pays the price. He has clipped it through mid-wicket and the batsmen get three.
Changes the angle and goes over the wicket. Bowls it full on off, Cook pushes it to mid off.
FOUR! Off the mark in style! On the pads, Cook loves it there, he flicks it through square leg and the ball races away.
Slightly fuller in length on off, Jennings strokes it towards wide mid off and takes a run.
Some zip off the surface for Bumrah. On the shorter side, that skids through. Jennings tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Slightly shorter on off, Jennings goes back and defends it onto the ground.
Hits the length hard on off, Jennings guides it to point.
Ends the over with a beauty. A full ball on off and Cook goes after it with hard hands. The ball goes towards backward point area where the field is set for such an uppish shot. He survives.
Again straying down the leg side. Too far away to make any connection.
Down the leg side, Cook fails to make connection.
On a length on off, defended.
On the pads, flicked to the on side for no run.
Outside off, on a length, Cook is half forward to have a poke and gets beaten.
On the shorter side, Jennings keeps it out. Second maiden in a row for Bumrah but again no swing was visible in this over as well.
On the stumps, Jennings blocks it out confidently.
Hits the length again on off, slanting it away from the batsman. He lets it be.
Lovely bowling! On a length and just outside the off stump. Jennings was not sure whether to play at it or not but does well to get his bat out at the last moment.
Just ahead of a length but the line is outside off, the batsman need not play at those.
Back of a length on off, Jennings defends it onto the ground.
And England are underway! He gets a ball on his pads, does not let the scoring opportunity go as he flicks it down to fine leg for a run.
On the stumps, Jennings is solid in defense.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
The outswinger this time. Jennings tries to defend but gets an outside edge towards gully. It did not carry as he played it with soft hands.

A huge appeal but not given! Height I feel was the issue there. On a length around off, this one comes back in with the angle. Jennings tries to defend for the outswing but gets beaten on the inside. The ball hits him on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Hawk Eye shows it is missing the leg pole.
OHHHH! Starts from around the wicket and bowls it full outside off. Jennings goes for the drive but gets beaten.
Ishant Sharma to bowl from the other end.
Slightly shorter in length and the line is outside off, Cook leaves it alone. A maiden to begin with by Bumrah.
On a length again around middle, Cook tries to defend but it goes off the outer half towards point.
A little too full outside off, Cook shoulders arms. No swing as of now for Bumrah.
Well bowled! Uses the angle to his advantage and slants it across the batsman. Cook pokes at it and gets beaten.
Back of a length on off, Cook is solid in defense.
Slightly shorter on middle, it comes back in. Cook tries to work it on the leg side but misses to get hit high on the pads. Pant appeals but he is the only one doing so.
